# Northwind Remote Work Policy

This policy explains how Northwind employees may work away from the office while keeping collaboration strong. It applies to all full-time and part-time staff in roles that have been approved as remote-eligible by their department head. Roles that require on-site equipment or customer contact are excluded.

## Scheduling

Employees agree a weekly pattern with their manager at the start of each quarter. The pattern should balance focused individual work with in-person collaboration, and teams are encouraged to choose shared anchor days so that office time is actually spent together.

FACT: Northwind allows up to 3 remote days per week for eligible roles.
FACT: Northwind requires core hours from 10 to 3 local time on all working days.
FACT: Northwind reviews remote arrangements every 6 months.

## Equipment and expenses

Northwind provides a laptop, headset and monitor for each remote-eligible employee. Additional furniture can be requested through the facilities team and is approved case by case. Internet costs are considered a personal expense unless an employee is required to work fully remotely for business reasons.

## Security expectations

Remote employees must connect through the company VPN, keep devices locked when unattended and avoid working on confidential material in public spaces. Printed documents containing customer data should not be taken home. Any lost or stolen device must be reported to IT on the same day.

## Performance

Remote work is a privilege linked to performance. Managers evaluate outcomes rather than hours online, but repeated missed meetings or unanswered messages during core hours may lead to a review of the arrangement. Employees can appeal a decision through their HR business partner.
